title: AI Voice Agents

listing.shortDescription: Build AI-powered voice systems for inbound calls, outbound calls, lead qualification, support and appointment booking.
listing.fullDescription: Voice is the hardest interface to get right: latency, interruptions, accents and background noise all show up immediately. We build voice agents around a real telephony stack, tune for sub-second turn-taking, and design conversations that fail gracefully — confirming details, handling silence, and handing off to a person the moment the caller asks. Every call is transcribed, scored and pushed into your CRM.

deliverables.title: Telephony integration
deliverables.description: Inbound and outbound calling, call routing, warm transfer and voicemail handling.

deliverables.title: Conversation design
deliverables.description: Scripted objectives, qualification logic, interruption handling and confirmation patterns.

deliverables.title: CRM write-back
deliverables.description: Transcripts, recordings, outcomes and structured fields synced to your pipeline automatically.

deliverables.title: Call quality review
deliverables.description: Scoring per call with the recordings and transcripts needed to tune the agent over time.

useCases: Appointment booking straight into a live calendar
Tier-one support with escalation to a human agent
